modes.name: a0_tip_sweep
modes.plus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward positive y.
modes.minus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward negative y.

modes.name: a0_tip_radial
modes.plus: Lift and extend the tip outward toward positive x.
modes.minus: Lift and retract the tip toward its root.

modes.name: a0_tip_raise
modes.plus: Raise the tip predominantly through the proximal bend.
modes.minus: Raise and fold the tip predominantly through the distal bend.

modes.name: a1_tip_sweep
modes.plus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward negative x and positive y.
modes.minus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward positive x and negative y.

modes.name: a1_tip_radial
modes.plus: Lift and extend the tip outward toward positive x and positive y.
modes.minus: Lift and retract the tip toward its root.

modes.name: a1_tip_raise
modes.plus: Raise the tip predominantly through the proximal bend.
modes.minus: Raise and fold the tip predominantly through the distal bend.

modes.name: a2_tip_sweep
modes.plus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward negative x and negative y.
modes.minus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward positive x and positive y.

modes.name: a2_tip_radial
modes.plus: Lift and extend the tip outward toward negative x and positive y.
modes.minus: Lift and retract the tip toward its root.

modes.name: a2_tip_raise
modes.plus: Raise the tip predominantly through the proximal bend.
modes.minus: Raise and fold the tip predominantly through the distal bend.

modes.name: a3_tip_sweep
modes.plus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward negative y.
modes.minus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward positive y.

modes.name: a3_tip_radial
modes.plus: Lift and extend the tip outward toward negative x.
modes.minus: Lift and retract the tip toward its root.

modes.name: a3_tip_raise
modes.plus: Raise the tip predominantly through the proximal bend.
modes.minus: Raise and fold the tip predominantly through the distal bend.

modes.name: a4_tip_sweep
modes.plus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward positive x and negative y.
modes.minus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward negative x and positive y.

modes.name: a4_tip_radial
modes.plus: Lift and extend the tip outward toward negative x and negative y.
modes.minus: Lift and retract the tip toward its root.

modes.name: a4_tip_raise
modes.plus: Raise the tip predominantly through the proximal bend.
modes.minus: Raise and fold the tip predominantly through the distal bend.

modes.name: a5_tip_sweep
modes.plus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward positive x and positive y.
modes.minus: Lift the tip and sweep it toward negative x and negative y.

modes.name: a5_tip_radial
modes.plus: Lift and extend the tip outward toward positive x and negative y.
modes.minus: Lift and retract the tip toward its root.

modes.name: a5_tip_raise
modes.plus: Raise the tip predominantly through the proximal bend.
modes.minus: Raise and fold the tip predominantly through the distal bend.

modes.name: trunk_forward
modes.plus: Shift the trunk toward positive x over the planted tips.
modes.minus: Shift the trunk toward negative x over the planted tips.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_left
modes.plus: Shift the trunk toward positive y over the planted tips.
modes.minus: Shift the trunk toward negative y over the planted tips.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.plus: Lower the trunk over the planted tips.
modes.minus: Raise the trunk over the planted tips.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: trunk_roll
modes.plus: Roll the trunk about positive x, raising its left side.
modes.minus: Roll the trunk about negative x, raising its right side.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along roll

modes.name: trunk_yaw
modes.plus: Turn the trunk about positive z over the planted tips.
modes.minus: Turn the trunk about negative z over the planted tips.

modes.name: trunk_pitch
modes.plus: Pitch the trunk about positive y, lowering its forward side, with coupled positive yaw.
modes.minus: Pitch the trunk about negative y, raising its forward side, with coupled positive yaw.

gaits.name: crawl
fail: moves: the turn turned 1.6 deg (at least 15.0 needed)
